method: Public multi-source, empirically informed simulation with same-city order-weather replay

demand.reference_area: Sao Paulo city subset of Olist public data
demand.timing_contract: Purchase timestamps are demand-timing proxies, not observed release timestamps for last-mile drone operations.
demand.spatial_contract: Twelve calibration-only abstract demand zones define a relative spatial distribution. They do not identify a warehouse, a platform location, or actual drone routes.

weather.primary_trigger_contract: P90 is fixed on development data before the 60-scenario primary holdout evaluation; P80 is a supplementary boundary condition.

energy.scope: External engineering energy envelope only; it is neither same-city nor target-aircraft telemetry.

not_empirically_estimated.vip_labels: No compatible public VIP or SLA field exists.
not_empirically_estimated.W3_and_Hs: Governance parameters and a structural plan-change measure; they require historical plan versions and organisational workload logs for empirical estimation.
not_empirically_estimated.platform_motion: Engineering scenario parameter absent platform and traffic trajectory data.
